label: Prometheus system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Prometheus locus that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Prometheus branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual ProA genes, ProA proteins, the ambiguous bare ProA label, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Prometheus locus, unresolved Prometheus trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
